about: Phase 292 parity fixture (292-01 writes it; 292-03's artifactParity292.fence.test.ts reads it). Every `bad` case must be REFUSED by BOTH the backend validate_args (test_292_artifact_parity.py) AND the frontend guard parseArtifactRecord after the lift below; every `good` case must be ACCEPTED by both. Rules only the backend refuses (a 1-step or 0-link diagram, from_artifact, a history placeholder echo, a null-filled call, a source number < 1) are tested in test_292_artifact_models.py and are never fixture cases. Each case is written the way the model sends it to show_artifact. THE LIFT (args -> stored ArtifactRecord) that the frontend test applies, mirroring the server: `kind` and `verdict` lower-cased; `kind` absent -> "step"; an optional string (edge label, cell text, event detail, event category) absent or blank after trimming -> null; `deadline` absent -> false; an integer `source` n -> {"document": "fixture.pdf", "page": null, "excerpt": "Fixture excerpt."}, absent -> null, any other value copied as-is; timeline events are copied in the order given (good cases are written already sorted; the server sorts, the guard does not); row_count = the item count (nodes / terms / events); caption = {row_count, sources: [], source_count: 0, lineage: null}; label = "<component> 1"; spec = {title, <component>: <the lifted encoding>}. A JSON object {"$repeat": s, "times": n} anywhere inside a case stands for s repeated n times (the v1 convention); this file does not use it.
